svg.title: Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya Interaction Variants and Chiral Spin Textures
svg.desc: Three-panel scientific comparison of FullMag's three non-aliasing DMI variants: (a) interfacial C_nv DMI stabilizing a 1D Néel cycloid and 2D Néel skyrmion, (b) isotropic B20 bulk DMI stabilizing a 1D Bloch helix and 2D Bloch skyrmion, and (c) rotated interfacial DMI stabilizing an in-plane Göbel 2019 bimeron.
